research_notes: Hip-Hop/R&B is the most-streamed core genre in the US (~30.7% of streams); 44% of 18-25s name hip-hop their favorite genre (BPI Seeking Community 2025).
12-34s stream more Hip-Hop/R&B than Country; 35-54s invert that (Coleman Insights). Electronica/Dance peaks at 25-39 and is weakest 60+.
Boomers index on nostalgia and long-standing favorites over discovery (NuVoodoo 2025); melody and clarity beat bass-heavy production.

Regional strongholds: K-pop ~half of South Korean streams; Latin is 8.2% of global streams and dominant in LATAM; Nigeria is 62.2% local repertoire (Afrobeats); India is the largest ad-supported market with Bollywood/Punjabi pop leading (Luminate/IFPI 2025).

Ad-music research: musical campaigns are ~27% better on recall and business effects; music-message congruence is the dominant effectiveness factor; slower tempos suit luxury/finance/wellness, faster suit action/sports CTAs (Advids, UCPress Music Perception).

Taste-cluster segments are modeled on co-listening structure: streaming platforms derive genres and audience groups from clusters of artists that the same listeners stream in succession / co-place in playlists (Spotify related-artists methodology, agglomerative listener clustering research). Each cluster below is anchored on artists with strong co-listening overlap.

segments.label: Gen-Z (16-24)
segments.description: TikTok-native; hip-hop is the #1 favorite genre (44%), but mood matters more than genre allegiance. High novelty tolerance, meme-adjacent sound works.

happy.prompt: bright energetic hyperpop with glossy synths and a bouncy beat

hype.prompt: hard-hitting trap beat with heavy 808 bass and aggressive energy

calm.prompt: dreamy bedroom pop with soft guitars and lo-fi texture

playful.prompt: quirky playful electronic pop with pitched vocal chops

segments.label: Young Millennials (25-34)
segments.description: Streaming-first; Electronica/Dance peaks in this 25-39 bracket. Nostalgia for 2010s indie and festival EDM; values authenticity over polish.

happy.prompt: feel-good indie pop with funky bass and warm analog synths

hype.prompt: festival house anthem with a euphoric drop

emotional.prompt: emotional alt-pop ballad with airy vocals and swelling pads

segments.label: Millennial Parents (30-45)
segments.description: Family-first purchase decision makers; respond to warmth, trust, and gentle optimism. Acoustic textures and human imperfection signal sincerity.

happy.prompt: warm happy acoustic folk pop with hand claps and whistling

calm.prompt: gentle fingerpicked acoustic guitar, cozy and reassuring

uplifting.prompt: uplifting acoustic pop that builds to a warm anthemic chorus

segments.label: Gen-X (45-60)
segments.description: Country and rock over-index in the 35-54 bracket; brand-loyal, skeptical of overproduced trend audio. Real instruments signal credibility.

hype.prompt: driving blues rock with a gritty guitar riff and live drums

happy.prompt: feel-good retro soul with horns and an upbeat groove

emotional.prompt: heartfelt heartland rock with chiming guitars and a steady build

segments.label: Boomers (55+)
segments.description: Nostalgia-driven, lowest interest in new-music discovery (only 9% highly engaged). Melody and clarity win; avoid abrasive or sub-bass-heavy sound.

happy.prompt: cheerful big-band swing with bright horns and brushed drums

calm.prompt: smooth late-night jazz with mellow piano and soft brushes

emotional.prompt: nostalgic orchestral ballad with warm strings and gentle piano

segments.label: Luxury / Premium (35+)
segments.description: High-income aspirational buyers; research shows slower tempos suit luxury positioning. Sound must feel expensive, spacious, restrained.

luxurious.prompt: elegant minimal piano and strings, spacious and expensive-sounding

epic.prompt: slow-building cinematic orchestral piece with restrained grandeur

romantic.prompt: sensual downtempo with deep textures and intimate atmosphere

segments.label: Sports & Fitness (18-40)
segments.description: Gym-goers and athletes; fast tempo maps to action per ad-music research. Sound must drive adrenaline, pace, and triumph.

hype.prompt: explosive sports anthem with stadium drums, heavy 808s and risers

epic.prompt: epic hybrid trailer music with pounding percussion and brass

uplifting.prompt: triumphant EDM anthem that feels like crossing a finish line

segments.label: Wellness & Mindfulness (25-50)
segments.description: Yoga, self-care, clean living; converts best at low energy (slow tempo suits healthcare/wellness trust-building per ad research).

calm.prompt: serene ambient piece with soft piano and warm pads, meditative

uplifting.prompt: gentle uplifting acoustic morning-light feeling, hopeful and clean

happy.prompt: softly happy acoustic groove, sunlit and unhurried

segments.label: India Youth (18-30)
segments.description: World's largest ad-supported streaming market; Bollywood + Punjabi pop + global pop fluency. Rhythmic hooks and desi-fusion percussion drive engagement.

happy.prompt: festive Indian pop with dhol percussion, bright vocal hooks and dance energy

hype.prompt: high-energy Punjabi bhangra-trap with dhol and heavy bass

romantic.prompt: romantic Indian melody with soft strings, flute and intimate vocals

segments.label: India Family (30-55)
segments.description: Multi-generational households; melody-led emotional storytelling, film-score and classical-fusion warmth. Arijit Singh-era balladry is the trust register.

emotional.prompt: emotional Indian film score with strings, bansuri flute and gentle tabla

happy.prompt: joyful Indian celebration music with melodic vocals and warm percussion

uplifting.prompt: inspiring Indian fusion that builds from sitar to a full orchestral swell

segments.label: LATAM Youth (18-30)
segments.description: Latin is 8.2% of global streams and dominant regionally; Mexico and Brazil are top-3 streaming growth markets. Dembow rhythm carries the message.

happy.prompt: sunny latin pop with a dembow groove and feel-good summer energy

hype.prompt: club-ready latin trap with heavy low end and confident swagger

romantic.prompt: slow romantic latin R&B with smooth vocals and warm guitar

segments.label: Hip-Hop Culture (16-32)
segments.description: Hip-Hop/R&B is the single most-streamed core genre (~30.7% US). Sneaker/streetwear adjacent; production credibility matters more than melody.

hype.prompt: menacing drill beat with sliding 808s and icy melodics

calm.prompt: smooth late-night R&B beat with mellow keys

luxurious.prompt: luxurious rap instrumental with cinematic strings over crisp drums

segments.label: Country & Heartland (25-55)
segments.description: Country over-indexes in the 35-54 bracket and is a top-5 US genre; truck/outdoor/value-brand affinity. Authenticity, storytelling, grit.

happy.prompt: upbeat summer country with claps, banjo and an open-road feel

epic.prompt: anthemic americana that builds with stomps, slide guitar and grit

emotional.prompt: heartfelt country ballad with acoustic guitar and warm vocals

segments.label: East Asia Youth (16-28)
segments.description: K-pop is ~half of all South Korean streams; Japan is a top-4 global market. Maximal polish, bright hooks, genre-blending production standards.

happy.prompt: bright polished K-pop style dance track with funky bass and layered hooks

hype.prompt: energetic future bass with a euphoric supersaw drop

playful.prompt: playful J-pop style electronic track, cute and hyper-melodic

segments.label: Afrobeats & Diaspora (16-35)
segments.description: Nigeria is 62.2% local repertoire — the most locally-loyal market in MEA. Afrobeats has crossed over globally via Burna Boy/Wizkid/Rema.

happy.prompt: sunny feel-good afrobeats with syncopated percussion and warm vocal melody

hype.prompt: driving amapiano groove with log drums and rolling bass

romantic.prompt: smooth afro-R&B with intimate vocals and a gentle dembow-adjacent sway

segments.label: MENA Youth (18-32)
segments.description: Arabic pop and franco-arabe rap dominate locally; maqam-inflected melody over trap-influenced production is the crossover register.

happy.prompt: festive Arabic pop with darbuka percussion and a bright melismatic hook

hype.prompt: Arabic trap with oud riffs over heavy 808s

romantic.prompt: romantic Arabic ballad with lush strings and expressive vocal melody

segments.label: Indie & Alt Tribe
segments.description: Co-listening cluster around Arctic Monkeys / The Strokes / Tame Impala / Mac DeMarco; values guitar texture and irony, allergic to overproduced pop.

happy.prompt: sunny psychedelic indie pop with a groovy bassline and jangly guitars

hype.prompt: driving garage rock with fuzzy riffs and relentless drums

calm.prompt: mellow slacker indie with warm tape saturation and lazy guitar

segments.label: Main-Pop Superfans
segments.description: Stan-culture cluster around Taylor Swift / Olivia Rodrigo / Sabrina Carpenter / Ariana Grande; highest playlist-share and lyric-quoting engagement of any tribe.

happy.prompt: glossy feel-good pop anthem with a huge singalong chorus

emotional.prompt: emotional pop ballad that builds from piano to a soaring bridge

playful.prompt: flirty playful pop with bouncy synth bass and winking energy

segments.label: Folk & Sad-Indie
segments.description: Cluster around Noah Kahan / Hozier / Bon Iver / Phoebe Bridgers; emotional sincerity converts, stomp-folk and falsetto catharsis.

emotional.prompt: heartbreaking indie folk with fragile vocals and swelling strings

uplifting.prompt: stomp-and-holler folk anthem building to a cathartic group chorus

calm.prompt: quiet fingerpicked folk, intimate and candlelit

segments.label: Pop-Punk / Emo Revival
segments.description: Twin-peaked cluster: millennials raised on blink-182 / Paramore / MCR plus the Gen-Z revival (MGK, jxdn). Nostalgia plus angst.

search_terms: fast pop punk energetic gang vocals
hype.prompt: fast pop punk with palm-muted verses exploding into a gang-vocal chorus

emotional.prompt: heartfelt emo ballad with clean guitars and aching melody

playful.prompt: bouncy playful pop punk with singalong woahs

segments.label: Metal & Hard Rock
segments.description: Highly loyal cluster from Metallica classics to Sleep Token / Ghost crossover; intensity and authenticity over polish, strong merch/gear spend.

hype.prompt: aggressive metal with downtuned riffs and pounding double-kick

dark.prompt: dark brooding industrial metal with ominous low riffs

epic.prompt: epic symphonic metal with orchestral swells over heavy guitars

segments.label: Festival EDM
segments.description: Main-stage cluster around Calvin Harris / Martin Garrix / Fred again.. / Skrillex; chases euphoria, drops, and shared peak moments.

hype.prompt: festival main-stage EDM with a massive supersaw drop

happy.prompt: feel-good summer dance track with a skippy garage groove

uplifting.prompt: euphoric progressive house that builds to a hands-in-the-air release

segments.label: Techno / Underground Club
segments.description: After-hours cluster around Charlotte de Witte / Peggy Gou / Fisher; minimal, hypnotic, too-cool-for-main-stage. Strong fashion crossover.

hype.prompt: driving peak-time techno with relentless kick and acid line

dark.prompt: dark hypnotic warehouse techno with cavernous reverb

luxurious.prompt: sleek deep house with warm sub bass, fashion-show cool

segments.label: R&B / Neo-Soul
segments.description: Cluster around SZA / Frank Ocean / Daniel Caesar / Summer Walker; intimacy, vocal runs and late-night atmosphere. Heavy repeat-listening behavior.

romantic.prompt: smooth neo-soul with lush keys and intimate late-night vocals

calm.prompt: mellow bedroom R&B, hazy and unhurried

luxurious.prompt: silky alt-R&B with expensive-sounding chords and space

segments.label: Alt / Conscious Hip-Hop
segments.description: Lyrics-first cluster around Kendrick Lamar / J. Cole / Tyler, The Creator; values craft, jazz textures and message over club bounce.

uplifting.prompt: uplifting jazz-rap instrumental with soulful horns and head-nod drums

calm.prompt: smooth boom-bap beat over dusty jazz piano

emotional.prompt: emotional hip-hop instrumental with soul chops and strings

segments.label: Lo-fi & Study-Jazz
segments.description: Background-listening cluster (Lofi Girl ecosystem, Laufey, Norah Jones adjacents); students and focus workers, hours-long session lengths.

calm.prompt: soft lo-fi beat with vinyl crackle and warm mellow keys

happy.prompt: light sunny jazz-pop with a gentle swing and playful piano

romantic.prompt: romantic soft jazz with brushed drums and tender chords

segments.label: Film-Score & Modern Classical
segments.description: Cluster around Hans Zimmer / Max Richter / Ludovico Einaudi; cinematic emotion without lyrics. Overlaps premium and 'thinking brand' audiences.

epic.prompt: epic cinematic score with string ostinatos building to full orchestra

emotional.prompt: emotional modern classical with felt piano and aching strings

calm.prompt: serene ambient classical, weightless and spacious

segments.label: Reggae / Dancehall & Island
segments.description: Cluster spanning Bob Marley classics to Sean Paul / Popcaan / soca; carnival energy and sunshine associations travel globally.

happy.prompt: sunny feel-good reggae with skank guitar and warm horns

hype.prompt: high-energy dancehall riddim built for a carnival crowd

calm.prompt: mellow roots reggae with dubby bass and easy sway

segments.label: Gospel & Christian Contemporary
segments.description: Cluster around Maverick City / Lauren Daigle / Kirk Franklin; one of the most engaged and trusting US ad audiences, values warmth and hope.

emotional.prompt: emotional worship ballad with piano and gentle strings

happy.prompt: joyful gospel-soul with hammond organ and celebratory energy

segments.label: Y2K / 2000s Nostalgia
segments.description: Throwback cluster (Usher / Beyoncé / Nelly / early-2000s pop-R&B) revived by TikTok; instant emotional shortcut for 25-40s buyers.

happy.prompt: upbeat 2000s R&B-pop with bling-era synths and a snap groove

hype.prompt: 2000s crunk-style club banger with shouted hooks

romantic.prompt: smooth 2000s slow jam with silky harmonies
